No fetched source states the interval ((p^3+p-1)/p^4,(p^3+p^2-p)/p^4) or the k=p^3+p-1-b(p-1) stratification. Hence narrowly new as packaged finite gap. PASS, with residual risk that standard p-group textbooks/classification implicitly contain the class-number formulas (failed search does not prove priority).
